title: PH60401: Science Of Complexity
text:
Syllabus
Syllabus mentioned in ERP

Basic ideas of complexity, Scaling, Self-Similarity and measures of complexity;
Complexities in classical systems (e.g. fluctuations in various chaotic and
random systems, nonlinear waves, cellular automata, bio-systems); Complexities
in quantum systems (disordered systems, scattering systems).
